what: Candidate for the radar and precipitation preset (D-69): six intensity classes by reflectivity. TWO ramps, chosen by the ground's luminance: lighter means heavier on a dark ground; darker means heavier on a light ground.

checker.palette_256_worst_pair_note: all pairs; an earlier figure here, 23.8, was for neighbouring classes only (red-team round 2)

replaces: the ramp of specimens 15a to 15d, which failed at 256 colours (S15-3)

first_version.defect: got LIGHTER from class 2 to class 3 under every kind of vision (lightness 52.4 then 57.7); the 256 version inverted under deuteranopia. Seen by HUM LEAD as specimen 22d (D-89) before the defect was found by red-team round 2.

history: As first filed there was one ramp, valid on a dark ground only: on a light ground its heaviest class was 3.1 from the ground. Found by the PLAN red-team (PL-AX-1).
